summary.headline: Fixed Stars and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological catalogue of fixed stars 18–24, giving their zodiacal positions, magnitudes, latitudes, and planetary temperaments, followed by predictions for people born when the stars are rising or culminating. The listed stars include the Northern Claw of Scorpio, Head of Gemini, Orion’s shoulders, Procyon, and stars associated with the Horse and Andromeda.
